title: JSON string escaping omits most control characters
evidence: src/books_json.erl:17-19 escape/1 handles only " \ and \n; a title/author containing a tab, carriage return, or other 0x00-0x1F byte is emitted raw, producing invalid JSON in the response body
suggestion: Escape \r, \t and \uXXXX for all control characters in escape/1

title: Hand-rolled JSON decoder accepts only a narrow grammar
evidence: src/books_json.erl:26-31 str/2 handles only \" \\ \n escapes and number/2 accepts only non-negative integers; a well-formed request body using \t, \uXXXX, a negative year, or a float throws and is caught as {error,invalid_json} -> 400
suggestion: Support standard JSON string escapes and signed/float numbers, or document the restricted subset

title: Author query filter parses only a lone author= param and does not percent-decode
evidence: src/books_http.erl:47-48 query_author/1 splits the whole query on '=' so 'limit=1&author=X' yields undefined (no filter), and uri_decode/1 only maps '+' to space (no %20 handling)
suggestion: Split the query on '&' first, match the author key, and percent-decode the value

title: Request body requires an explicit Content-Length header
evidence: src/books_http.erl:24 defaults Content-Length to 0 when the header is absent, so a POST/PUT without Content-Length is treated as an empty body and fails validation with 400
suggestion: Read to EOF (Connection: close) or support chunked transfer when Content-Length is missing
